name: 复活节
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 2:00 前往鹈鹕镇广场
timeHintEn: Enter Pelican Town between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM
planningTips: 预留金币购买草莓种子
提前完成农场浇水和收获后再进城
planningTipsEn: Finish watering and harvesting before entering town

name: 花舞节
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 2:00 从巫师塔南侧进入煤矿森林
timeHintEn: Enter Cindersap Forest south of the Wizard's Tower between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM
planningTips: 想邀请舞伴需要目标 NPC 至少 4 心
节日前优先对目标 NPC 对话和送礼
planningTipsEn: A dance partner needs at least 4 hearts
Talk to and gift the target NPC before the festival

name: 夏威夷宴会
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 2:00 前往海滩
timeHintEn: Enter the Beach between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM
planningTips: 准备高品质食材加入汤品
当天先处理农场事务再前往海滩
planningTipsEn: Prepare a high-quality ingredient for the soup
Handle farm chores before going to the Beach

name: 月光水母之舞
planningTips: 这是夏季最后一天，确认夏季作物已收获
提前安排第二天秋季开局物资
planningTipsEn: This is the last day of summer; harvest summer crops first
Prepare supplies for the first day of fall

name: 星露谷展览会
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 3:00 前往鹈鹕镇广场
timeHintEn: Enter Pelican Town between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM
planningTips: 尽量覆盖多个类别并选择高品质物品
planningTipsEn: Cover multiple categories and prefer high-quality items

name: 万灵节
timeHint: 晚上 10:00 后前往鹈鹕镇
planningTips: 预留夜间时间探索迷宫
可获取金南瓜作为高价值奖励
planningTipsEn: Reserve the evening for the maze
The Golden Pumpkin is a valuable reward

name: 冰钓节
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 2:00 前往煤矿森林
timeHintEn: Enter Cindersap Forest between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM
planningTips: 留出时间参加冰钓比赛
planningTipsEn: Make sure you have a fishing rod
Leave time for the ice fishing contest

name: 夜市
timeHint: 下午 5:00 至凌晨 2:00 前往海滩
timeHintEn: Visit the Beach from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM
planningTips: 连续 3 天开放，关注稀有商品
可安排深海钓鱼和美人鱼船事件
planningTipsEn: Open for 3 consecutive nights with rare shops
Plan for deep-sea fishing and the Mermaid Boat

name: 冬日星盛宴
timeHint: 上午 9:00 至下午 2:00 前往鹈鹕镇
timeHintEn: Enter Pelican Town between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM
planningTips: 这次送礼不占普通 NPC 每周送礼上限
planningTipsEn: Prepare a gift for your secret friend
This gift does not use the normal weekly NPC gift limit
